description: Recipe scaler + unit converter — Scale a recipe's ingredient lines from servings= to to= (or factor=). Parses whole numbers, decimals, fractions, mixed numbers, unicode fractions and ranges; converts awkward volumes to sensible units (tsp/tbsp/cup); rounds whole items like eggs and cloves with a note; leaves 'to taste' lines alone. system=metric converts US volumes/weights to ml/g, system=us converts metric to cups/oz. Lines separated by ';' or new lines. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

recipe.description: e.g. 2 cups flour; 1 1/2 tsp baking soda; 3 eggs; 1/4 cup sugar

name: util_recipe_scale
